title: 第3章 三寸小鞋

content_zh:
我的外套师傅明明送给张老汉了，为什么会穿在师傅身上？
师傅还被车撞死了！
更诡异的是，警察居然说师傅是凌晨3点多死的，可当时师傅明明还跟我在一起。
我跟师傅是在平头村附近遇上张老汉的，估计张老汉应该是平头村人。
我坐面包车来到平头村。
几个大妈大婶正在村口一棵上百年的大槐树树荫下嬉笑闲聊，看见我一个陌生的小伙进了村，都嘴角挂着笑的斜眼打量我。
我长的还凑活，我走了过去：“请问，咱村有一个卖豆腐脑的张老汉吗？”
其中一个磕着瓜子的胖大妈望着我笑盈盈的道：“有啊，啥事儿？”
我顺口就编了一个谎：“我有件衣服放他那儿了，跟他说好了，今天过来拿。”
我话刚说完明显感觉到现场突然一下子静了下来，捎首弄姿的大妈大婶全都定在了原地，像看怪物一样看着我。
足足过了三四秒钟。
那个磕瓜子的大妈说道：“小伙，逗你婶玩呢吧！”
她的脑门上有细细的汗珠渗了出来，脸色也变得异常的难看，眼中更有一丝恐慌。
我很茫然：“我真来找张老汉的。”
大妈慌忙说道：“你自己进村问吧。”
我也懒得跟这些大妈大婶闲扯，进了村稍微一打听就知道张老汉家的住址了。
张老汉家住的很坳，孤零零的一间屋坐落在山脚，上去还挺麻烦，要顺着石头堆砌的阶梯上去。
这样的路我走起来都感觉难，更何况是一个七八十岁的老人。
而且石阶杂草丛生。
心想难道这里都没人打理吗？

我到时他家的木门敞开着。
农村就是这样，只有到了晚上睡觉才会关门。
“有人吗？”
我在门口叫了一声。
“谁啊”
一个老头从里屋走了出来，正是张老汉。
“你是？”
张老汉眯着眼睛仔细打量我，昨天夜里张老汉虽然见过我，但他毕竟上了年纪而且天又黑恐怕没看清楚。
我说：“是这样的，昨天夜里我跟师傅迷路，遇上您老给我们指路。”
张老汉恍然大悟：“原来是小哥啊，快，快请进屋。”
不知道是不是坐落山阴的关系，张老汉家里凉飕飕的。
进屋就看见一张八仙桌，上面摆着一张16寸的遗照，不过用白布遮住了，不知道是张老汉什么人的，遗照前摆放着一个香炉，还插了三根香。
香还点着。
张老汉请我在八仙桌旁的长凳上坐下。
我刚坐下就听见咯咯笑的声音，我抬头问张老汉：“听没听见有人笑？”
张老汉摇了摇头：“没有啊，小哥今天来是……”
在来的路上我就想好理由了。
我说：“我师傅不是送了件衣服给你么，兜里有点紧要的东西忘记拿出来了。”
张老汉尴尬道：“小哥真对不住，衣服我给弄丢了。”
我瞪大了眼睛：“弄丢了？”

张老汉道：“早上我在菜市场卖豆腐的时候觉的天热，就把衣服给脱了……”，
他一拍大腿很懊恼的说道：“不想，不想……给弄丢了，兜里有什么要紧的东西，要不，要不……我赔给你。”
我连忙摆手，哪里有什么东西，只是一个借口：“不用，不用，丢了就算了。”
张老汉眯着眼睛打量我。
我被他看得很不舒服：“张大爷，我脸上怎么啦？你这样盯着我看。”
张老汉神情变的肃穆起来：“小哥，你印堂发黑，满脸阴气，是不是招惹了什么不干净的东西。”
昨晚之前，有人跟我说这句话，我一定会骂他骗子。
但这会，我在心中直呼高人。
我就像溺水的人抓到了浮漂，把昨天夜里被红衣女鬼纠缠，还有我师傅被车撞死的事一股脑全说了出来。
张老汉听完说道：“我说呢，衣服怎么会突然就没了？”
他叹了口气，说道：“小哥，你不该去招惹那只女鬼。”
我感到很冤枉，我根本没招惹女鬼，是路上遇见的好么：“没有，我根本没招惹她。”
张老汉道：“没有？我问你，你是不是想她了。”
我闹了一个大脸红。
说老实话，我第一眼看到红衣女鬼时，确实很骚包的春心荡漾了，可我要是知道她是只女鬼，打死我都不敢。
张老汉皱着眉头：“穿红衣服的女鬼是最凶的，会要人命的，你师傅就是个例子，估计她今天晚上就会找你索命。”
听到索命两个字，我吓的眼珠子都快掉出来了，激动的站起来喊道：“今晚！”

content_en:
The master of my coat obviously gave it to Old Man Zhang. Why is it worn by the master?
The master was also hit and killed by a car!
What’s even more weird is that the police actually said that the master died around 3 a.m., but the master was still with me at that time.
My master and I met Old Man Zhang near Pingtou Village. It is estimated that Old Man Zhang is from Pingtou Village.
I took a van to Pingtou Village.
Several aunties were laughing and chatting under the shade of a century-old locust tree at the entrance of the village. When they saw me, a strange boy, entering the village, they all looked at me sideways with a smile on their lips.
I grew up and could still make do with it, so I walked over and said, "Excuse me, is there an old man Zhang who sells tofu bread in our village?"
One of the fat aunts who was chewing melon seeds looked at me and said with a smile: "Yes, what's the matter?"
I made up a lie smoothly: "I left some clothes at his place. I told him that I would come and pick them up today."
As soon as I finished speaking, I could clearly feel that the place suddenly became silent. The aunties and ladies who were making fun of me all froze in place and looked at me like I was a monster.
A full three or four seconds passed.
The aunt who was cracking melon seeds said: "Young man, let's tease your aunt!"
There were thin beads of sweat on her forehead, her face became extremely ugly, and there was a trace of panic in her eyes.
I was at a loss: "I really came to see Old Man Zhang."
The aunt said hurriedly: "Go to the village and ask yourself."
I was too lazy to chat with these aunties, so I found out the address of Old Man Zhang's home after a little inquiry after entering the village.
Old man Zhang lives in a very lonely house at the foot of the mountain. It is quite troublesome to go up. You have to go up the stairs made of stones.
It is difficult for me to walk on such a road, let alone an old man in his seventies or eighties.
And the stone steps are overgrown with weeds.
I wonder if no one is taking care of it here?
The wooden door of his house was open when I arrived.
This is how it is in rural areas. The doors are closed only when you go to bed at night.
"Is there anyone?"
I called at the door.
"Who?"
An old man walked out of the back room, it was Old Man Zhang.
"You are?"
Old Man Zhang squinted his eyes and looked at me carefully. Although Old Man Zhang had seen me last night, he was old after all and it was dark, so he might not have seen me clearly.
I said, "It's like this. The master and I got lost last night, and you always showed us the way when we met."
Old man Zhang suddenly realized: "It turns out to be little brother. Come on, please come in."
I don’t know if it’s because it’s located in Shanyin, but it’s chilly in Old Man Zhang’s house.
When I entered the room, I saw an Eight Immortals table with a 16-inch posthumous photo on it, but it was covered with white cloth. I don't know who it belonged to, Old Man Zhang. There was an incense burner placed in front of the photo, and three incense sticks were inserted.
The incense is still burning.
Old man Zhang invited me to sit down on the bench next to the Eight Immortals table.
As soon as I sat down, I heard the sound of giggling. I looked up and asked Old Man Zhang, "Did you hear anyone laughing?"
Old man Zhang shook his head: "No, I'm here today..."
On the way here I thought of a reason.
I said, "Didn't my master give you some clothes? I forgot to take out some important things in my pocket."
Old man Zhang said awkwardly: "Brother, I'm so sorry. I lost my clothes."
My eyes widened: "Lost it?"
Old man Zhang said: "I felt hot when I was selling tofu in the vegetable market in the morning, so I took off my clothes..."
He patted his thigh and said in annoyance: "I don't want to, I don't want to... I lost it. There is something important in my pocket. Otherwise, otherwise... I will compensate you."
I waved my hand quickly, there was something there, it was just an excuse: "No, no, just throw it away."
Old man Zhang looked at me with squinted eyes.
I felt very uncomfortable when he looked at me: "Uncle Zhang, what's wrong with my face? You're staring at me like this."
Old man Zhang's expression became solemn: "Brother, your hall is dark and your face is full of gloom. Is it because of the evil spirit?"Something dirty happened. "
Before last night, if someone said this to me, I would definitely call him a liar.
But this time, I called the master in my heart.
I was like a drowning man caught on a float. I told him everything about being haunted by the female ghost in red last night and about my master being hit and killed by a car.
After hearing this, Old Man Zhang said: "Let me tell you, why did the clothes suddenly disappear? "
He sighed and said, "Brother, you shouldn't provoke that female ghost. "
I felt very wronged, I didn’t provoke the female ghost at all, I just met her on the road, okay: “No, I didn’t provoke her at all. "
Old man Zhang said: "No? I ask you, do you miss her. "
I blushed deeply.
To be honest, when I first saw the female ghost in red, I felt very coquettish and excited, but if I knew she was a female ghost, I wouldn’t dare to kill her.
Old Man Zhang frowned: "The female ghost in red is the most ferocious and can kill people. Your master is an example. She will probably come to you tonight to claim her life." "
When I heard the word "death", I was so scared that my eyes almost popped out. I stood up excitedly and shouted: "Tonight! "
